Summary: Audit publish failed: produce() got on_delivery as the partition argument
Description: confluent_kafka.Producer.produce's 4th positional parameter is `partition`; passing the callback positionally failed every audit publish (26/26 in e2e). Fixed with keyword args; regression test uses the real client.

Summary: MinIO images removed from Docker Hub/Quay break `make up`
Description: minio/minio and minio/mc no longer pull ('repository does not exist'). Switched compose to bitnamilegacy/minio (same server, ships mc).

Summary: `make prom-test` glob never expanded inside the container
Description: promtool received the literal 'prometheus/rules/*.yml'. Now runs via sh -c inside the container.

Summary: Compose set MODEL_VERSION instead of ML_MODEL_VERSION for forecasting-service
Description: The forecaster version override never reached the service. Compose now sets ML_MODEL_PATH / ML_MODEL_VERSION.

Summary: REQ-004: broker ack p95 above 50 ms on the single-broker local stack
Description:
JMeter at 2 000 events/s (acks=all, batch 100, 8 threads) on Docker Desktop: ack p50 27 ms, *p95 407 ms*, p99 2.1 s; throughput 1 454 events/s because producer threads wait on slow tail acks. Lag stayed < 2 000 records and all 87 000 events were ingested, scored and archived.

*Next:* re-run on the EKS deployment (3 brokers, RF=3) — loadtest/run-load-test.sh --rate 10000 — and tune linger/batch.size if needed.

Summary: Run diagnostic Kafka consumer and API in separate processes
Description: Under 1.4k events/s from normalized-events, POST /score p95 is 138 ms but *p99 1.36 s* (14/545 calls > 500 ms): the consumer thread and the API share one Python process (GIL). Split into a consumer Deployment and an API Deployment, or run the consumer with multiprocessing.

Summary: JMeter fails on JDK 26 (Groovy 'Unsupported class file major version 70')
Description: JMeter 5.6.3's launcher on macOS picks the newest JDK. run-load-test.sh now pins JDK 21/17 when JAVA_HOME is unset.

Summary: anomaly_audit_published_total lags when anomalies are rare
Description: confluent-kafka only runs delivery callbacks inside poll(); AuditPublisher polled only on the next publish, so with rare anomalies the published/failed counters (and AnomalyAuditPublishFailing) lagged until the next anomaly. Records themselves were delivered. Fixed with a background poller thread; covered by test_audit_delivery_callbacks_served_in_background.

Summary: GraphRAG root-cause analysis
Description: Explain every anomaly and predictive alert: 2-hop dependency context from Neo4j + local LLM (Ollama) → ranked incident playbook (docs/adr/0010).

Summary: Temporal Fusion Transformer forecaster
Description: Forecast platform metrics 60 min ahead with a TFT trained on the platform's own Prometheus history; Holt as fallback (docs/adr/0010).

Summary: Neo4j dependency graph seeded from the service catalogue
Description: 15 components (producers, Kafka/ZooKeeper, pipeline services, S3, Neo4j, Ollama, Prometheus, Grafana) and their calls/depends_on/publishes_to/consumes_from edges; diagnostic-service seeds an empty database and falls back to the in-memory seed if Neo4j is down.

Summary: Anomalies trigger GraphRAG automatically
Description: IncidentTrigger batches anomalies per component (5 s), one diagnosis per component per cooldown (600 s), single worker so the local LLM is never overloaded. Playbooks published to the incident-playbooks topic.

Summary: Predictive alerts get a GraphRAG playbook
Description: forecasting-service posts each new alert to POST /diagnose in the background and stores playbook_id on the alert (ADR-0001 client restored).

Summary: Run Ollama (llama3.2:3b) in docker compose
Description: ollama + one-shot ollama-pull in compose; LLM_PROVIDER=ollama by default, rule-based fallback on timeout or malformed output.

Summary: Local LLM is OOM-killed while the TFT trains
Description: On a 7.7 GB Docker VM the TFT training job (~3 GB) plus the stack leaves no room for llama-server; Ollama logs 'signal: killed' and diagnoses fall back to rules. Don't train during a demo; raise Docker Desktop memory to 10 GB+ or use a 1B model.

Summary: Write live health back into Neo4j
Description: Seed health_status is static. Update node health from the console/Prometheus probes so GraphRAG ranks genuinely degraded dependencies first.

Summary: Kubernetes manifests for Neo4j and Ollama
Description: Compose runs both; infra/k8s has no StatefulSet for Neo4j or Deployment for Ollama yet (EKS GPU/CPU node sizing to decide).

Summary: Train the TFT on local Prometheus history
Description: training/train_tft.py: NaN cleaning, splits series at scrape gaps > 5 steps, capped batches per epoch so make train-tft finishes in ~15 min on CPU; checkpoint + JSON sidecar with model_version.

Summary: Serve the TFT with a direct forward pass
Description: TFTForecaster runs one batch through the network instead of model.predict (which builds a Lightning Trainer per call); FORECASTER=auto picks TFT, then ar-ridge, then Holt; Holt covers any failed prediction.

Summary: Demo console dashboard (port 9099)
Description: Live event flow with Kafka offsets, topic throughput chart, consumer lag, container health, GraphRAG playbooks, TFT status and a 7-step guided demo. Docker blue / Kafka charcoal theme, light and dark.
